messages.author: 8419786a214f97ef
messages.subject: Priors
parts:
Hello there,
I am running a space time model in inla and would like to set my prior as :

# Hyperprior distribution on the inverse variance parameter of the unstructured and structured random effects
    tau.u ~ dgamma(0.01, 0.01)
    tau.s ~ dgamma(0.01, 0.01) #    tau.s ~ dunif(0,100)    #en paper de

and for B0:

beta0 ~ dnorm(0, 0.01)


how to do I do in into INLA:

formula.intI<- y ~ + f(county,model="bym", graph="municBa",adjust.for.con.comp=FALSE)+
  f(year,model="rw2") + f(year2,model="iid") + f(X,model="iid")

mod.intI <- inla(formula.intI,family="zeroinflatedpoisson0",data=data_nice_space_time,E=exp,
                 control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE),
                 control.compute=list(dic=TRUE,cpo=TRUE), num.threads = 5, verbose = T)

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Priors
parts:
On Wed, 2016-07-20 at 20:08 -0700, Gustavo Machado wrote:
> Hello there, 
> I am running a space time model in inla and would like to set my
> prior as :
>
> # Hyperprior distribution on the inverse variance parameter of the
> unstructured and structured random effects
>     tau.u ~ dgamma(0.01, 0.01) 
>     tau.s ~ dgamma(0.01, 0.01) #    tau.s ~ dunif(0,100)    #en paper
> de
>
> and for B0:
>
> beta0 ~ dnorm(0, 0.01)
>
>
> how to do I do in into INLA:
>
> formula.intI<- y ~ + f(county,model="bym",
> graph="municBa",adjust.for.con.comp=FALSE)+
>   f(year,model="rw2") + f(year2,model="iid") + f(X,model="iid")
>

hyper = list(prec = list(prior = "loggamma", param = c(0.01, 0.01)))

then add

f(..., hyper = hyper)

for the model 'rw2', I would recommend to add scale.model=TRUE; see 

http://www.r-inla.org/examples/tutorials/tutorial-on-option-scale-model


--
Håvard Rue
he...@r-inla.org

yes, for the bym you'll need two as the parmaeters have different name

prec.unstruct = list(
prior = "loggamma",
param = c(0.1,0.1)),
prec.spatial = list(
prior = "loggamma",
param = c(0.1,0.1)))
